name: Migrate Source GraphQL
description: Migrate source plugin that runs one configured query against a GraphQL endpoint and yields the returned nodes as migration source rows.
project_description: This module extends the list of core migration sources by adding a new GraphQL query source. Like Migrate Source CSV, you create a migration YAML file that configures a GraphQL endpoint and a query from which to extract the content, then run the migration with the standard Migrate/Drush workflow. The source plugin (id: graphql) reads the endpoint URL, an optional Authorization scheme/parameter, an optional data_key property path, and a query definition (query name, optional arguments, and fields) from the migration's source configuration. It builds the query with the gmostafa/php-graphql-client library, sends a single POST request, walks the JSON response down the configured data_key path (supporting a '%' token to map across an indexed array), dispatches a ResultsEvent so other modules may alter the result set, and yields each result decoded as an associative array of source-row values. It does not implement automatic pagination or cursor-following; any paging must be expressed as query arguments in the migration YAML.
